newsitem.title: USA: Bowater agrees to sell Star Forms.
newsitem.headline: Bowater agrees to sell Star Forms.

text.p: Paper producer Bowater Inc. said Monday it has signed an agreement to sell its computer forms company, Star Forms Inc., for $80 million to CST Office Products, Inc.
The purchase, expected to be finalised in the fourth quarter, will be completed for $60 million in cash and $20 million in notes, Bowater said.
CST Office Products is a privately-held paper-product company based in Wheeling, Ill.
Bowater, which is the largest newsprint producer in the United States, said it expects to report a gain after the sale is completed.
Bowater's stock fell 25 cents to $37.125 in morning trading on the New York Stock Exchange.
